title: Prover UX, portability, and operational privacy baseline audit
scope: research/prover-operations/** only; frozen v0.3 inputs are read but never changed
inputs: the 480 artifact paths and SHA-256 values declared by the 60 run records

executable.dependencies: Python 3 standard library plus the committed focused schema validator

outputContract.decimalPolicy: Source decimal spellings are retained; mean and population standard deviation use Decimal arithmetic and round half-even to 12 decimal places; p90/p95/p99 use nearest rank.

gateContract.required: Complete H1/H2/H3 measurements and a practical CLI workflow
gateContract.reason: No H1 cold runs, no H2/H3 runs, and no implemented practical end-user CLI are committed.

solidityMeasurementProfile.applicability: No Solidity is compiled or measured by SP-73; this is the required profile for any future Solidity-side measurement.
